scope: simulation-only Stand causality, reward, and contact audit

baseline_causal_reward.dominant_failure: waist_pitch soft/hard-limit chain; right ankle did not reach its hard limit

gain_clip_causal_reward.dominant_failure: COM support-margin crossing followed by right ankle actual hard limit or base height

gain_clip_waist_frozen.conclusion: policy waist-pitch residual is not a necessary cause of the downstream ankle/height failure

gain_clip_sole_box.conclusion: sole box improves initial load symmetry but does not remove the dynamic ankle/height failure

waist_pitch_350_zero_action.conclusion: raising one waist axis moves the zero-action failure to another waist axis

classified_findings.right_ankle_chain: policy target oscillates and reaches its positive action clip, while actual position later diverges to the hard limit; terminal effort is about 17-20 Nm, consistent with the configured 50/2 PD error rather than the 118.2 Nm effort limit
classified_findings.normal_policy_gain_contract: 50/2 ankle gains match the checked-in A3 normal policy path; 500/5 belongs to PD_STAND and is not an interchangeable Base policy gain
classified_findings.contact_geometry: current Isaac URDF import uses convex_hull, not raw triangle-mesh rigid contact; it produces an unexplained initial load asymmetry that a foot-only sole box removes
classified_findings.reward: per-term integration matches the returned reward, but there is no explicit termination penalty; immediate auto-reset makes completed-episode return insufficient to prove a preference for 10-second survival
classified_findings.waist: neither a single waist-pitch gain increase nor freezing the policy waist-pitch residual establishes a stable plant working point

required_work: select and version a contact-geometry candidate after static and dynamic symmetry checks
derive a reachable nominal pose and bounded target offsets under the deployable normal-policy gain contract
validate zero/scripted target rollouts without hard-limit migration or unexplained contact asymmetry
add and offline-test an explicit failure/termination reward candidate with Isaac dt semantics
create a new fail-closed gate before any extended smoke
not_authorized: copy PD_STAND gains into the Base policy contract
start domain randomization, strike support, locomotion, or deployment

next_ppo_candidate.note: Measured 53% deterministic actor-mean clipping is not attributed solely to stochastic exploration.
